slides.sub: Qatar property sales fell 39.1% week-on-week, Nov 15–21, 2026 · Aqarat

captions.linkedin:
Qatar's weekly property sales dropped 39% last week.

According to Aqarat (the Real Estate Regulatory Authority), sales between 15 and 21 November came to about QR337.1 million across 105 transactions: down 39.1% in value and 22.2% in deals versus the previous week.

Two details stand out:
→ Villas made up roughly half of the sales value, and vacant land about 37%.
→ Mortgage value rose 83.6% week-on-week, to about QR266.8 million.

What it means for agencies:
One week is not a trend. Weekly figures in Qatar swing a lot; the Ministry of Justice bulletin for 8–12 November reported more than QR564 million. But a slower week is a good moment to work the pipeline you already have instead of waiting for new enquiries.

Three things to do this week:
• Call back every lead that went quiet in the last 30 days
• Check your villa listings are accurate and live on every portal
• Ask finance-ready buyers where they are in the mortgage process

(Keeping every lead, stage and follow-up in one place is why we built OneLinker CRM.)
